title: Kolkata to Host Pravasi Bharatiya Divas 2027 as Registration Website Launches
excerpt: Jaishankar and West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari launched the 19th PBD website in New Delhi; Modi will inaugurate the January 7-9 convention and President Murmu will close it.
body:
• The 19th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas convention will be held in Kolkata from January 7 to 9, 2027, and online registration is now open on the convention website launched on November 11.
  • External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar and West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari jointly launched the website in New Delhi; Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the convention and President Droupadi Murmu will preside over the valedictory session.
  • The theme is "From Roots to Return: Reigniting Diaspora Connect with Bharat," and the programme opens with a Youth Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.
  • A Bharat Ko Janiye quiz runs from November 11 to December 20, 2026, with winners in NRI, PIO and foreign-national categories receiving a 10-day trip to India and an invitation to the convention.

The Indian diaspora is not merely connected to India through its past but is an integral part of the country's present and an important stakeholder in its future, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Wednesday, November 11, at the launch of the website for the 19th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) convention, according to Connected to India.

The convention will be held in Kolkata from January 7 to 9, 2027, in collaboration with the West Bengal government. The website was jointly launched by Jaishankar and West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari in New Delhi, the Ministry of External Affairs said, marking the start of online registrations.

Modi to inaugurate, President to close

The main convention will be inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, while President Droupadi Murmu will preside over the valedictory session, at which the Pravasi Bharatiya Samman Awards will be conferred, the MEA said, as reported by NewKerala. The three-day programme begins with a Youth Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.

The convention's theme is "From Roots to Return: Reigniting Diaspora Connect with Bharat." The convention website, pbdindia.gov.in, is designed as a single point of information for participants, carrying the programme, registration procedures, accommodation, logistics, advisories and tourist information for Kolkata and its surroundings, Jaishankar said.

Why Kolkata

"I am particularly pleased that Kolkata will host the 19th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas because Kolkata occupies a very special place both in the history of India and in the history of the Indian diaspora. From here, many Indians set sail for Mauritius, Fiji, the Caribbean, and other destinations, carrying with them their languages, customs, and faith."

— S Jaishankar, External Affairs Minister

Jaishankar described the diaspora as a "living bridge" between India and the world, and said overseas Indians would play an increasingly important role in India's journey towards Viksit Bharat by 2047, through their knowledge, expertise, entrepreneurial spirit, technological capabilities and global networks.

Quiz, app and how to take part

Jaishankar also announced a special Bharat Ko Janiye quiz, running from November 11 to December 20, 2026. Winners from three categories — Non-Resident Indians, Persons of Indian Origin and foreign nationals — will receive a 10-day trip to India and an invitation to the Kolkata convention, according to the MEA announcement. An AI-enabled app, Bharat Verse, will host games, quizzes and puzzles through the year.

Pravasi Bharatiya Divas commemorates Mahatma Gandhi's return to India from South Africa on January 9, 1915, and the convention has been held biennially since 2015. For diaspora readers planning to attend, registration is through the convention website, which also carries the accommodation and travel information needed to plan the January trip.
nri_angle: PBD is the diaspora's flagship convention: registration is open now for the January 7-9, 2027 Kolkata edition, with a quiz offering winners a 10-day India trip.
